_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. gofundme.com declares its design-token layer as ~700 `--hrt-*` custom properties on :root / the consumer theme scope (raw/css-vars.json): semantic colour roles, size/spacing/radius scales, the type system, motion and z-index — every resolved consumer value is published under its own name. The /c/* pages are the WordPress content stack and /sign-in the auth boundary; their values are measured. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
